V0._is_not: ⛔ NOT 'selected vs executed'. Both label streams are EXECUTED manoeuvres — the arm's own and the human's. Scoring a DECLARED decision against the driven path needs a tactical head (hierarchy.run's maneuver_vs_trajectory kappa) and stays unavailable on a trajectory dump.
